tasks.description: Phase 20.3 pool-selection pre-check: for each missing shape, query currentImpulseShapes (from lifecycle payload) to find existing pool candidates matching shape + predicate. When candidates exist, dispatches impulse_pool_selection to rank them by impulse_relevance Thompson posteriors. When no candidates exist, returns {no_pool_candidates:true} gracefully. Runs in parallel with select_or_produce (both depend on prepare_pool); their outputs together feed agent_fill_fallback and escalate_unbindable.

Per-shape producer discovery iterating over lifecycle.missingShapes. Runs after pool_precheck; dispatches producer_selection for shapes that have no existing pool candidates (complementary to pool_precheck which covers shapes that already have candidates).
LLM-of-last-resort: invokes SessionMemoryAgent.fillMissingShapes via impulse_preparation.agent_fill.

Phase 10 P4.5 / 10.24: before triggering recursive create-shape-provider-goal escalation, consult activity-api's shape_gap_resolution cache (migration 105 + impulses.ts:1148 sibling case). Cache hits surface (resolved_by, resolution_type) tuples that downstream consumers can short-circuit recursion with. Best-effort: a backend miss or empty result-set yields a degraded-but-non-fatal impulse so the rest of the chain runs.
